campos.descripcion: Description For excellent accuracy time-keeping - when your everyday RTC (Real Time Clock) won't do - the Adafruit RV-8803 Precision Real Time Clock Breakout Board is a tick-tock above the rest with excellent ±1.5 ppm (at 0~50°C) accuracy. Thanks to the built-in crystal with temperature compensation management, classic RTC drift is minimized so you don't have to do any time correction with WiFi or GPS to keep current. Compare it to the popular DS3231 , with ±2 ppm (0~40°C), you get even tighter spec'd performance, at a better price! This is a great battery-backed real time clock (RTC) that allows your microcontroller project to keep track of time even if it is reprogrammed, or if the power is lost. Perfect for data-logging, clock-building, time stamping, timers, and alarms, etc. Equipped with RV-8803 RTC - it can run from 3.3V or 5V power & logic - and keep excellent time with under 50 seconds of drift over a whole year. There's also some nifty extras like square-wave out, timer alarm, event timestamping (you can use the built in button to activate an event, or use the breakout pads) Works great with an Arduino using our RTC library , with CircuitPython , or with a Raspberry Pi (or similar single board linux computer) thanks to built-in kernel support. Note: This product does not come with a CR1220 coin cell battery. We recommend you purchase a coin cell battery to use with this product. The battery is required in order to keep time when power is lost, and will last at least 5 years before needing to be changed. We've taken the RTC and put it onto a breakout PCB along with support circuitry to let you use it with 3.3V (Feather/Raspberry Pi) or 5V (Arduino/ Metro328) logic levels. Additionally, since it speaks I2C you can easily connect it up with two wires (plus power and ground!). We've even included SparkFun qwiic compatible STEMMA QT connectors for the I2C bus so you don't even need to solder! QT Cable is not included , but we have a variety in the shop . Just wire up to your favorite micro and you can use our CircuitPython/Python or Arduino drivers to easily interface with the RV-8803. Comes as a fully assembled and tested breakout plus a small piece of header. You can solder header in to plug it into a breadboard, or solder wires directly.

Su computación de alto rendimiento y bajo consumo para el Deep Learning y la visión por computadora la convierte en la plataforma ideal para proyectos de computación intensiva. NVIDIA® Jetson Orin Nano™ Super , es la versión mejorada del Jetson Orin Nano y otras tarjetas predecesoras, establece nuevos alcances de la densidad de computación, la eficiencia energética y las capacidades de inferencia de IA en los dispositivos en el edge. Esto lo hace ideal para máquinas autónomas como robots de entrega y logística, sistemas de fábricas y grandes vehículos aéreos no tripulados industriales. NVIDIA® Jetson Orin Nano™ Super es una computadora pequeña y poderosa para aplicaciones integradas de inteligencia Artificial, posee una GPU de Arquitectura NVIDIA Ampere con 1024 núcleos CUDA y 32 núcleos Tensor , una CPU Arm® Cortex®-A78AE v8.2 de 64 bits de 6 núcleos L2 de 1,5 MB + L3 de 4 MB, una memoria RAM 8 GB LPDDR5 128 bits 102 GB/s y compatibilidad con E/S de alta velocidad, que permite ejecutar múltiples redes neuronales en paralelo para aplicaciones como clasificación de imágenes, detección de objetos, segmentación y procesamiento de voz. Posee WiFi gracias a la tarjeta Wifi/Bluetooth instalada en el conector PCIe M.2 KEY E. El kit proporciona todas las herramientas que necesitas para comenzar de inmediato, ya que es compatible con los SDK JetPack y DeepStream de NVIDIA, así como con las bibliotecas de software CUDA®, cuDNN, TensorRT y un amplio ecosistema de software de IA. Cet ensemble Home Cinéma réunit un ampli-tuner AV 7.2 canaux, cinq enceintes compactes dont deux compatibles Dolby Atmos et un caisson de basses actif. Pensé pour les amateurs de cinéma, de jeux vidéo et de musique, il permet de profiter d'un son surround tridimensionnel tout en bénéficiant des technologies audio et vidéo modernes. Au cœur de cette installation, l'amplificateur Onkyo TX-NR6100B dispose de sept canaux d'amplification et délivre jusqu'à 175 W par canal sous 6 ohms (1 kHz, 10 % THD). Compatible avec les formats audio Dolby Atmos et DTS:X , il permet de restituer les effets sonores tridimensionnels des contenus compatibles. Sa certification THX Certified Select accompagne cette conception dédiée au Home Cinéma, tandis que le système de calibration automatique AccuEQ ajuste la restitution sonore en fonction de l'acoustique de la pièce. Côté vidéo, ses six entrées HDMI, dont trois HDMI 2.1 , assurent la prise en charge des signaux 8K à 60 Hz et 4K à 120 Hz . Les technologies HDR10+ et eARC complètent ses fonctionnalités pour une installation audiovisuelle polyvalente. Les deux enceintes Dolby Atmos disposent également d'un haut-parleur large bande de 100 mm orienté vers le plafond, permettant de diffuser les effets sonores en hauteur par réflexion. Cette conception apporte une dimension verticale à la scène sonore pour les films et les contenus compatibles. Il intègre également Chromecast built-in , DTS Play-Fi et la compatibilité Works with Sonos pour faciliter la diffusion musicale et l'intégration dans un environnement multiroom. Les services Spotify, Deezer, Tidal et Amazon Music sont également pris en charge. Grâce à ses deux sorties HDMI, dont une compatible eARC, à son entrée phono et à ses nombreuses connexions audio, cet amplificateur centralise différentes sources de divertissement. Associé au système Focal Sib Evo 5.1.2, il permet de constituer une véritable installation Home Cinéma avec effets surround et canaux de hauteur, tout en conservant un format d'enceintes compact pour une intégration dans le salon. campos.nombre: Adafruit CP2105 Friend - USB to Dual UART Serial Converters
campos.descripcion: Description On our first Pentium 120 tower ( purchased at PCs for Everyone on Thorndike st in Cambridge Mass ) came with two DE-9 serial ports on the back: COM1 and COM2. Perfect for connecting a mouse and maybe a modem. Nowadays, long gone are the days of parallel ports and serial ports. Now the USB port reigns supreme! But USB is hard, and you just want to transfer your every-day serial data hither & thither from two serial ports to a single USB port without the complexity of a hub. What now? Enter the Adafruit CP2105 Friend ! The CP2105 is very similar to the CP2102N . Except, instead of having a single serial UART port, it has two . One is 'standard' and one is 'enhanced' - you'll get both enumerated when plugging in this device, without any hub required! The Enhanced port can do: Data formats supported: - Data bits: 5, 6, 7, and 8 - Stop bits: 1, 1.5, and 2 - Parity: odd, even, mark, space, no parity Baud rates: 300 bps to 2.0 Mbps 320 Byte receive and transmit buffers Modem control signals: CTS, RTS, DTR, DSR and RI The Standard port can do: Data format: 8 data bits, 1 Stop bit Parity: Even, Odd, No parity Baud rates: 2400 bps to 921600 bps 288 Byte receive and transmit buffers Modem control signals: CTS, RTS, DTR, DSR and RI Please note: we have pre-programmed this board with the "modem signal" one-time fuse so those modem signals will 'just work' but you cannot use them as GPIOs like a fresh-from-the-reel chip. Like the CP2102N breakout, we have USB C connector and the same overall shape, but there are some significant changes. The pins are going to be totally different because we have two UARTs, one on either 'side' of the board. The left side is the Enhanced port, right side is the Standard port. We don't have extra GPIO pads and no indicator LEDs. Also the bottom row is a 'minimal' output of just the two RX/TX pads and power pins. We like the CP210x series because it has better driver support than the CH340 and can do very high speeds, and variable speeds without stability issues. Compared to the FT232RL and FT231X, the CP210x has the same capabilities or better, at a great price! Each order comes with a fully assembled and tested board. We give you some pin header strip, solder it in to plug it into a breadboard and get access to all the pins. For Linux you won't need a driver. For Windows, it will automatically grab the driver from Windows Update. For Mac OS X you can check out SiLabs driver page for the latest and greatest .

Description
PaperMono is an e-paper development board built around low-power display, near-field identification, and long-range communication capabilities. It features a touch-enabled 3.97-inch 4-level grayscale monochrome e-paper display, driven by SSD1677 with a resolution of 480 x 800, and integrates an FT6336G touch controller and a frontlight system for a more comfortable reading and interaction experience in low-light environments. The core adopts an ESP32-S3R8, paired with 16MB Flash, 8MB PSRAM, and 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi, along with an onboard buzzer, PDM microphone (LMD4737T261-AC02), RGB LED, BMI270 6-axis IMU, M5IOE1 IO expander, microSD card slot, and RX8130CE real-time clock. The NFC section is based on the ST25R3916, supporting ISO14443A, ISO14443B, FeliCa™, and ISO15693; LoRa communication adopts the SX1262 (Stamp LoRa-1262) solution with a built-in FPC antenna, supporting the 868MHz ~ 923MHz band. Combined with the M5PM1 multi-level power management system and a 1150mAh battery, it meets the requirements of low-power IoT and embedded applications such as e-readers, e-paper signage, access control terminals, identity authentication, and intelligent transportation.
Note
E-Paper Usage Precautions
Avoid direct sunlight/prolonged sun exposure during use; high temperatures or strong UV can damage the panel.
After approximately 10 partial fast refreshes in software, it is recommended to perform one full-screen refresh to clear the screen and avoid severe accumulated ghosting.
The screen has built-in OTP waveforms that can be called directly. When using custom external waveforms, pay attention to DC balance; otherwise, irreversible damage may be caused to the panel.
Avoid uninterrupted continuous partial fast refreshes, to prevent long-term DC imbalance from causing irreversible damage to the panel.

campos.descripcion: Impressora 3D Flashforge Creator 5 A Impressora 3D Flashforge Creator 5 foi criada para quem quer dar um salto real na impressão multicolor e multimaterial, sem abrir mão de velocidade, precisão e praticidade. Diferente dos sistemas tradicionais que dependem de um único bico compartilhado entre as cores, a Creator 5 traz 4 toolheads (bicos extrusores) totalmente independentes, cada um com seu próprio filamento carregado. Isso significa que, ao trocar de cor, a impressora simplesmente estaciona um bico e ativa outro, sem precisar purgar filamento no processo, resultando em peças multicoloridas muito mais rápidas, limpas e econômicas. Essa arquitetura de múltiplos bicos é o que permite à Creator 5 imprimir modelos multicoloridos até 500% mais rápido do que impressoras com sistema de troca única, além de reduzir drasticamente o desperdício de material durante as trocas de cor. Na prática, isso representa mais peças entregues por hora, menos filamento jogado fora e resultados visuais muito mais ricos, ideais para personagens, logotipos, protótipos, peças decorativas e produtos personalizados com acabamento profissional. A estrutura CoreXY de alta rigidez da Creator 5 sustenta velocidades de impressão de até 300mm/s, deslocamento de até 600mm/s e aceleração de até 30.000mm/s², mantendo estabilidade mesmo em trabalhos longos e detalhados. O sistema de calibração de offset entre os 4 bicos é totalmente automático, assim como o nivelamento da mesa, o que reduz falhas de alinhamento entre cores e torna o preparo da impressão muito mais simples, mesmo para quem está começando com sistemas multicolor. Com bicos de aço endurecido que suportam até 320°C e mesa aquecida de até 120°C com plataforma flexível em aço mola PEI texturizada, a Creator 5 é compatível com uma ampla variedade de materiais: PLA, PETG, TPU-90A, TPU-95A, TPU-64D, PLA-CF, PETG-CF, Silk, PVA e BVOH. Isso possibilita combinar, em um único projeto, materiais rígidos e flexíveis, cores diferentes e até suportes solúveis, ampliando bastante o potencial de criação técnica e estética. A impressora também conta com compensação inteligente de fluxo (Auto PA Calibration), o que ajuda a manter a qualidade de impressão consistente mesmo em altas velocidades, evitando falhas comuns como sobre-extrusão ou marcas visíveis entre camadas. Para acompanhamento remoto, a Creator 5 traz uma câmera Full HD integrada com resolução de 1280x720 a 30fps, permitindo monitorar a impressão de qualquer lugar, e função de gerenciamento de múltiplas impressoras, ideal para quem opera mais de um equipamento ao mesmo tempo, como em fazendas de impressão. Recursos de segurança e conveniência completam o pacote: detecção de fim de filamento, retomada automática após queda de energia, iluminação interna da câmara e ligar/desligar com um único toque. A conectividade via Wi-Fi dual-band 2.4G/5G e USB garante flexibilidade para enviar arquivos e monitorar impressões de diferentes formas, com compatibilidade para os softwares de fatiamento Orca-Flashforge e OrcaSlicer. Com volume de impressão de 256 x 256 x 256mm e operação silenciosa (abaixo de 55dB no modo silencioso), a Flashforge Creator 5 entrega o equilíbrio perfeito entre velocidade, qualidade multicolor e facilidade de uso. É a impressora indicada para makers, famílias, escolas e pequenos negócios que querem produzir mais, gastar menos filamento e explorar todo o potencial da impressão multicor e multimaterial. Compacta para o que entrega, robusta e pensada para um fluxo de trabalho multicolor de verdade, a Flashforge Creator 5 é a escolha certa para quem quer transformar ideias em peças finais cheias de cor, detalhe e qualidade profissional. Principais Aplicações A Impressora 3D Flashforge Creator 5 atende desde projetos criativos até aplicações técnicas mais exigentes. Em impressões multicolor, permite criar personagens, miniaturas, logotipos, placas, brindes personalizados e peças decorativas com acabamento muito próximo do produto final, sem depender de pintura manual. Para prototipagem, ajuda designers e engenheiros a apresentar conceitos com clareza, diferenciando componentes, encaixes e detalhes por cor ou material. Em escolas e laboratórios, a Creator 5 facilita a criação de modelos didáticos mais intuitivos, em que cores diferentes ajudam a explicar estruturas e funcionamentos. Já para famílias e makers, é a porta de entrada para projetos multicoloridos de alta qualidade sem complicação. campos.nombre: Módulo IMU MPU6500 + BMP280: Acelerómetro, Giroscopio, Altímetro I2C
campos.descripcion: INFO El módulo GY-91 integra el IMU MPU6500 y el barómetro BMP280 , logrando un total de 7 grados de libertad (DoF) y contiene todo lo necesario para realizar rastreo de movimiento espacial de un Drone o UAV. Combina un giroscopio de 3 ejes, un acelerómetro de 3 ejes y un altímetro en un mismo chip. El IMU MPU6500 integra un DMP (Procesador digital de movimiento) capaz de realizar complejos algoritmos de captura de movimiento de 6 ejes. Para una captura precisa de movimiento rápido y lento, posee un rango de escala programable de 250/500/1000/2000 grados/seg para el giroscopio, 2g/4g/8g/16g para el acelerómetro. El sensor de presión barométrica BMP280 (evolución del BMP180) posee alta precisión y un bajo consumo de energía. Ofrece un rango de medición de 300 a 1100 hPa (Hecto Pascal). Basado en tecnología BOSCH piezo-resistiva con gran robustez EMC, alta precisión y linealidad, así como con estabilidad a largo plazo. Presenta diversas mejoras respecto al sensor BMP180 como: mejor resolución de presión y temperatura, mejor precisión, mejores filtros digitales y un menor consumo de energía. Los sensores MPU6500 y BMP280 comparten el mismo bus de comunicación I2C. La integración con Arduino a nivel de software es muy sencilla pues existen librerías listas para ser usadas. A nivel de hardware el modulo incluye un regulador de 3.3V en placa, además de resistencias pull-up en el bus I2C. El módulo GY-91 posee alta integración y precisión, ideal para ser utilizado en Drones, solo basta añadir un Módulo GPS y podremos construir un sistema de navegación autónoma. Ces écouteurs intra-auriculaires Bluetooth associent un format ultracompact, une réduction de bruit active (ANC) et la technologie Jabra MultiSensor Voice pour faciliter les échanges dans différents environnements. Grâce à leur adaptateur Bluetooth USB-C Plug-and-Play , leur connexion multipoint et leur autonomie totale pouvant atteindre 33 heures avec le boîtier de charge, ils offrent une solution pratique pour enchaîner réunions, appels et déplacements. technologie vocale avancée pour des communications claires Les Jabra Evolve2 Buds intègrent la technologie Jabra MultiSensor Voice , qui combine quatre microphones, deux capteurs à conduction osseuse et des algorithmes Jabra pour optimiser la captation de la voix lors des conversations. Leur système audio comprend six microphones MEMS et une fonction de réduction du bruit du vent, particulièrement utile lors des appels en déplacement. La réduction de bruit active (ANC) , associée à l'isolation passive des embouts en silicone, aide à limiter les distractions sonores pour favoriser la concentration. La fonction HearThrough permet, quant à elle, d'entendre les sons environnants sans retirer les écouteurs. La technologie Jabra SafeTone , associée à PeakStop, contribue également à protéger l'audition contre les pics sonores soudains. Les haut-parleurs de 6 mm assurent une restitution audio adaptée aux conversations comme à l'écoute musicale. connectivité polyvalente et une autonomie adaptée aux journées actives Conçus pour simplifier le travail hybride, les Jabra Evolve2 Buds USB-C UC disposent de la technologie Advanced Bluetooth Multipoint , permettant de maintenir simultanément une connexion avec un ordinateur et un smartphone. L' adaptateur Bluetooth USB-C fourni facilite leur utilisation avec un ordinateur et offre une portée sans fil pouvant atteindre 20 mètres. Pensés pour les communications unifiées, ces écouteurs s'intègrent aux principaux outils de collaboration professionnels. Leur conception repose sur l'analyse de 62 000 scans d'oreilles afin de proposer un format discret et confortable. Certifiés IP57 , ils résistent à la poussière et à l'eau. Leur boîtier compatible avec la recharge sans fil Qi et leur fonction de charge rapide, offrant jusqu'à une heure d'utilisation après cinq minutes de charge, complètent leurs atouts pour une utilisation mobile. campos.nombre: Adafruit TMF8806 Time of Flight Distance Sensor - 10mm to 5m - STEMMA QT / Qwiic
campos.descripcion: Description The Adafruit TMF8806 Time of Flight Sensor is a great Time of Flight distance sensor from ams Osram in the TMF series of chips. The TMF8806 in particular can do 20mm to 5 meters at up to 30 Hz update rate, and a dedicated low-power 200mm mode. It also has a wider field-of-view The sensor contains a very tiny invisible laser source and a matching sensor. The TMF8806 can detect the "time of flight", or how long the light has taken to bounce back to the sensor. Since it uses a narrow light source, it is good for determining distance of only the surface directly in front of it. Unlike sonars that bounce ultrasonic waves, the 'cone' of sensing is narrower, in this case about 30° short range (under 200mm) and 21° above. Unlike IR distance sensors that try to measure the amount of light bounced, the TMF is much more precise and doesn't have linearity problems or 'double imaging' where you can't tell if an object is very far or very close. One nice thing about this sensor is that while it does not require a firmware 'patch' on boot for 5 meter mode and the SRAM usage is also much lighter, so it fits easily in small memory boards like the ATmega328. You can use it on many 8-bit microcontroller devices. There is a 10 meter mode that does require a firmware patch but its only 3K and will also fit if you want it! Please note: The TMF8806 datasheet/firmware implies it can do 10 meter ranging but we weren't able to get results past 5 meter even after the firmware upload step, and there may be an undocumented calibration step required. Either way, we would call this a 5m distance sensor and not a 10m. The sensor is small and easy to use in any robotics or interactive project. Since it needs 3.3V power and logic we put the little fellow on a breakout board with a regulator and level shifting. You can use it with any 3-5V power or logic microcontroller with no worries. Works great with the 3.3V logic level of a Feather, or the 5V level of a ATmega , this breakout is ready to work with most common microcontrollers or SBCs. and since it speaks I2C, you can easily connect it up with two data wires plus power and ground. As if that weren't enough, we've also added SparkFun qwiic compatible STEMMA QT connectors for the I2C bus so you don't even need to solder. Just wire up to your favorite micro with a plug-and-play cable to get ToF data ASAP. For a no-solder experience, just wire up to your favorite micro using a STEMMA QT adapter cable. The Stemma QT connectors also mean the TMF8806 can be used with our various associated accessories. QT Cable is not included, but we have a variety in the shop Communicating to the sensor is done over I2C, check out our Arduino and CircuitPython/Python code to get started fast and read data over I2C in a jiffy. Assim como a Creator 5, ela conta com 4 toolheads (bicos extrusores) totalmente independentes, cada um carregado com seu próprio filamento, o que elimina a purga entre trocas de cor e torna a impressão multicolor até 500% mais rápida do que sistemas de bico único, com muito menos desperdício de material. O grande diferencial da Creator 5 Pro está em sua câmara totalmente fechada e com aquecimento ativo de até 65°C, projetada para eliminar empenamento, rachaduras e problemas de aderência em materiais exigentes como ABS, ASA, nylon e compósitos reforçados. Com temperatura estável em toda a câmara, as camadas ficam mais uniformes e o resultado final é consistentemente mais preciso, mesmo em peças grandes ou geometrias complexas. Para garantir um ambiente de trabalho mais seguro e confortável, a Creator 5 Pro conta com sistema de filtragem de ar HEPA13 (grau médico) e carbono ativado, que retém poeira e compostos orgânicos voláteis liberados por materiais como ABS e ASA. O design fechado ainda reduz o ruído de operação de 65dB para até 55dB, tornando a impressora adequada para uso em escritórios, escolas e ambientes compartilhados. A estrutura rígida em câmara fechada sustenta velocidades de impressão de até 300mm/s, deslocamento de até 600mm/s e aceleração de até 30.000mm/s², mantendo estabilidade mesmo em impressões longas. A calibração de offset entre os 4 bicos e o nivelamento da mesa são totalmente automáticos, e a compensação inteligente de fluxo (Auto PA Calibration) garante acabamento impecável, com menos falhas visuais entre camadas. Com bicos de aço endurecido que suportam até 320°C e mesa aquecida de até 120°C com plataforma flexível em aço mola PEI texturizada, a Creator 5 Pro amplia consideravelmente a compatibilidade de materiais em relação à versão padrão, suportando desde PLA, PETG e TPU até materiais técnicos como ABS, ASA, PA-CF, PET-CF, PAHT-CF, ASA-CF, ASA-GF, ABS-GF, PPA-CF, PPS-CF e HIPS, além de suportes solúveis como PVA e BVOH. A conectividade via Wi-Fi dual-band 2.4G/5G e USB garante flexibilidade no envio de arquivos, com compatibilidade para os softwares de fatiamento Orca-Flashforge e OrcaSlicer. Com volume de impressão de 256 x 256 x 256mm, a Flashforge Creator 5 Pro entrega o equilíbrio ideal entre velocidade multicolor, controle térmico e robustez para quem trabalha com impressão 3D em nível profissional. Compacta mesmo com câmara fechada, silenciosa e preparada para materiais técnicos, a Flashforge Creator 5 Pro é a escolha certa para engenheiros, designers, escolas técnicas e pequenos negócios que precisam de resultados consistentes em peças multicoloridas e materiais de engenharia. campos.nombre: Adafruit Stereo I2S 3W Amplifier Breakout - Dual MAX98357A
campos.descripcion: Description Listen to this good news - we now have an all in one digital audio amp breakout board that works incredibly well with the Raspberry Pi or any other microcontroller with I2S output! If you're looking for an easy and low cost way to get your digital sound files bumpin' then the Stereo MAX98357A I2S Amp Breakout is for you. It takes standard I2S digital stereo audio input and, not only decodes it into analog, but also amplifies it directly into a speaker. Perfect for adding compact amplified sound, it takes 2 breakouts (I2S DAC + Amp) and combines them into one. This Stereo MAX98357A takes all the audio goodness you know and doubles up on it. With an additional terminal block and MAX chip your audio projects get to be heard in stereo as it now has separate left and right channels. I2S (not to be confused with I2C) in a digital sound protocol that is used on circuit boards to pass audio data around. Many high end chips and processors manage all of the audio in digital I2S format. Then, to input or output data, three or four pins are used (data in, data out, bit clock and left-right channel select). Usually, for audio devices, there's a DAC chip that will take I2S in and convert it to analog that can drive a headphone. This small stereo amplifier is surprisingly powerful - able to deliver 3.2 Watts of power into each 4 ohm impedance speaker (5V power @ 10% THD). Inside the miniature chip is a class D controller, able to run from 2.7V-5.5VDC. Since the amp is a class D, it's incredibly efficient - making it perfect for portable and battery-powered projects. It has built in thermal and over-current protection but we could barely tell it got hot. The audio input is I2S standard, you can use 3.3V or 5V logic data. The outputs are "Bridge Tied" - that means they connect directly to the outputs, no connection to ground. The output is a ~300KHz square wave PWM that is then 'averaged out' by the speaker coil - the high frequencies are not heard. All the above means that you can't connect the output into another amplifier, it should drive the speakers directly. There's a Gain pin that can be manipulated to change the gain. By default, the amp will give you 9dB of gain. By connecting a pullup or pull down resistor, or soldering the on-board jumper, the Gain pin can be set up to give 3dB, 6dB, 9dB, 12dB or 15dB. Works great with Raspberry Pi, Arduino, ESP32 and any other microcontroller or microcomputer with I2S audio outputs Specs : Output Power per channel: 3.2W at 4Ω, 10% THD, 1.8W at 8Ω, 10% THD, with 5V supply PSRR: 77 dB typ @ 1KHz I2S sample rates from 8kHz to 96kHz No MCLK required Five pin-selectable gains: 3dB, 6dB, 9dB, 12dB, 15dB Excellent click-and-pop suppression Thermal shutdown protection Comes as an assembled and tested breakout board with pre-soldered terminal blocks, with a small piece of optional header. Some soldering is required to attach the header. Check out the tutorial for schematics, diagrams, examples and more!

It has built in thermal and over-current protection but we could barely tell it got hot.
The audio input is I2S standard, you can use 3.3V or 5V logic data. The outputs are "Bridge Tied" - that means they connect directly to the outputs, no connection to ground. The output is a ~300KHz square wave PWM that is then 'averaged out' by the speaker coil - the high frequencies are not heard. All the above means that you can't connect the output into another amplifier, it should drive the speakers directly.
There's a Gain pin that can be manipulated to change the gain. By default, the amp will give you 9dB of gain. By connecting a pullup or pull down resistor, or soldering the on-board jumper, the Gain pin can be set up to give 3dB, 6dB, 9dB, 12dB or 15dB.
Works great with Raspberry Pi, Arduino, ESP32 and any other microcontroller or microcomputer with I2S audio outputs

campos.nombre: ESP32 DevKit V1
campos.descripcion: La ESP32 DevKit V1 es la placa de desarrollo de referencia para quien empieza con el ESP32 y también para el maker que quiere una base fiable en producción. Este formato, conocido como NodeMCU ESP32 , integra en una sola placa el módulo WROOM-32, la conectividad WiFi y Bluetooth, el conversor USB a serie CP2102 y una doble hilera de 30 pines pensada para pinchar directamente en una protoboard. La versión que ofrecemos incorpora conector USB-C , más cómodo y reversible que el antiguo micro USB. Qué es la ESP32 DevKit V1 DevKit V1 es el nombre del formato de placa: una PCB de 30 pines con el módulo ESP32-WROOM-32 soldado, regulador de tensión a bordo, botones de EN (reset) y BOOT, y el chip CP2102 que gestiona la comunicación entre el ordenador y el microcontrolador por USB. Es la placa que la mayoría de tutoriales, cursos y librerías toman como referencia, así que casi cualquier ejemplo que encuentres funcionará sin adaptaciones. Se alimenta por el propio USB-C o por el pin VIN (5V), y ofrece salidas reguladas de 3.3V para tus sensores y módulos. Conectividad WiFi y Bluetooth para IoT El corazón de la placa es el módulo WROOM-32, con doble núcleo y radio WiFi 802.11 b/g/n más Bluetooth Classic y BLE. Esa combinación es lo que hace de esta placa la opción natural para el Internet de las Cosas: estaciones meteorológicas conectadas, domótica, paneles de control por app móvil, sensores que publican datos en la nube, mandos BLE o pasarelas entre dispositivos. Todo con un consumo contenido y modos de bajo consumo (deep sleep) para proyectos a batería. Pinout y pines GPIO La ESP32 DevKit V1 expone 30 pines repartidos en dos hileras. Además de alimentación (VIN, 3V3, GND), dispone de numerosos GPIO multifunción: entradas analógicas (ADC), salidas PWM, dos buses I2C, cuatro SPI, varios UART, pines táctiles capacitivos y salidas DAC. Conviene tener a mano el pinout de la placa, porque algunos pines tienen usos reservados durante el arranque. Con esta placa cubres desde un simple parpadeo de LED hasta control de motores, lectura de múltiples sensores o manejo de pantallas. Programación con el IDE de Arduino La placa es totalmente compatible con el entorno de Arduino : basta con instalar el soporte de placas ESP32 y seleccionar "DevKit V1". Gracias al chip CP2102, la subida de programas es directa por USB-C, normalmente sin pulsar botones manualmente. También es compatible con MicroPython, ESP-IDF y PlatformIO, de modo que la placa crece contigo a medida que tus proyectos se vuelven más ambiciosos. Datos técnicos ESP32 DevKit V1 Formato: DevKit V1 / NodeMCU ESP32, 30 pines Módulo: ESP32-WROOM-32 (doble núcleo Xtensa LX6 de 32 bits) Conector: USB-C Chip USB a serie: CP2102 Conectividad: WiFi 802.11 b/g/n + Bluetooth Classic y BLE Memoria: 448 KB ROM, 520 KB SRAM, flash SPI 4 MB Alimentación: USB-C 5V o pin VIN; salida regulada 3.3V ADC: SAR de 12 bits, hasta 18 canales DAC: 2 conversores de 8 bits Sensores táctiles capacitivos: 10 Buses: 2 x I2C, 4 x SPI, 2 x I2S, 3 x UART PWM: control de motores y hasta 16 canales LED Extras: sensor Hall, sensor de temperatura interno, CAN 2.0, Ethernet MAC Aplicaciones habituales Estaciones meteorológicas conectadas, domótica y control por app, robótica WiFi, registradores de datos en la nube, mandos y sensores Bluetooth de bajo consumo, paneles con pantalla, proyectos de aula y prototipos IoT. Si buscas una versión más pequeña para integrar en espacios reducidos, tienes la ESP32-S2 Mini ; y si quieres empezar con todo lo necesario, echa un vistazo al Kit IoT ESP32 .
